messages:
Priya (Docs): Found a couple of bad anchors on the structured-output page and an example that assumes tools is always an array. Opened a tiny PR to fix anchors + add migration notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/611
Marco (SDK): Great — can we include both TS and Python snippets showing a resilient parse pattern (tools may be null) and mention an SDK helper if available?
Zoe (Eng-ML): Confirming older runners sometimes emitted null for empty tool lists. Runtime change planned to emit [] by default, but docs should handle both shapes.
Priya (Docs): Plan: add a Compatibility section with: 1) TS and Py parse shims, 2) a minimal JSON Schema that allows array or null, and 3) a one-line unit test in docs/tests/snippets to ensure snippet doesn't throw when tools=null.
Tomas (Eng-Runtime): Runtime will flip to [] for v2 next week. No rollback planned. Docs note should clarify timeline.
Preview-Bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-611--docs.redwood.ai/structured-output (expires in 48h) :white_check_mark:
Marco (SDK): Suggested TS snippet: ```ts
const envelope = await client.generate(...);
const tools = Array.isArray(envelope.tools) ? envelope.tools : (envelope.tools == null ? [] : [envelope.tools]);
// process tools safely
```
Priya (Docs): Adding that and a Python equivalent. Also will include this JSON Schema guardrail: ```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"tools":{"type":["array","null"],"items":{"type":"object"}}},"required":["tools"]}
```
Zoe (Eng-ML): Nice. Please add a short blurb about why older responses had null (backcompat for sparse tool outputs) so readers understand context.
Priya (Docs): Will do. Targeting to merge today after CI. I'll post the final changed file list here when merged.
Marco (SDK): LGTM, will follow up with an SDK helper PR to align examples after docs lands.
Priya (Docs): Thanks all!
